name: Beverages, packaged food and beverage shops

NASDAQ_COCO.name: The Vita Coco Company
NASDAQ_COCO.why: Coconut-water brand owner with outsourced production; also makes private-label drinks for retailers.

NASDAQ_FIZZ.name: National Beverage
NASDAQ_FIZZ.why: Owns LaCroix, Shasta and Faygo and makes them in its own plants.

NASDAQ_KDP.name: Keurig Dr Pepper
NASDAQ_KDP.why: Owns and partly bottles Dr Pepper, Canada Dry and other soft-drink brands plus the Keurig coffee system; JDE Peet's added in 2026.

NYSE_KO.name: The Coca-Cola Company
NYSE_KO.why: Sells concentrate and finished drinks under its own brands; bottling is mostly refranchised to independent bottlers.

NASDAQ_MNST.name: Monster Beverage
NASDAQ_MNST.why: Energy-drink brand owner; manufacturing outsourced and distribution through Coca-Cola bottlers.

NASDAQ_PEP.name: PepsiCo
NASDAQ_PEP.why: Owns Pepsi, Gatorade and other drink brands; about 40% of revenue is beverages, the rest is Frito-Lay and Quaker snacks and food.

NASDAQ_CELH.name: Celsius Holdings
NASDAQ_CELH.why: Energy and functional drink brands (Celsius, Alani Nu, Rockstar US/Canada); outsourced production, PepsiCo distribution.

NASDAQ_SUJA.name: Suja Life
NASDAQ_SUJA.why: Cold-pressed juice and functional drink brands made in its own plant.

XLON_BAG.name: A.G. Barr
XLON_BAG.why: Owns IRN-BRU, Rubicon and other UK soft-drink brands and makes them itself.

XLON_CCH.name: Coca-Cola HBC
XLON_CCH.why: Coca-Cola bottler for 29 countries in Europe and Africa (Nigeria, Egypt; CCBA added in 2026).

NASDAQ_COKE.name: Coca-Cola Consolidated
NASDAQ_COKE.why: Largest US Coca-Cola bottler (Southeast and Mid-Atlantic territories).

NYSE_FMX.name: FEMSA
NYSE_FMX.why: Holding company that consolidates Coca-Cola FEMSA (the largest Coca-Cola bottler by volume) and runs OXXO convenience stores; retail is now the larger part of revenue, so the tag is approximate.

NASDAQ_CCEP.name: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners
NASDAQ_CCEP.why: Coca-Cola bottler for Western Europe, Australia/Pacific and Southeast Asia.

NYSE_PRMB.name: Primo Brands
NYSE_PRMB.why: Spring-water brands (Poland Spring, Pure Life) with its own sourcing, bottling and home/office delivery network.

NYSE_AKO.B.name: Embotelladora Andina
NYSE_AKO.B.why: Coca-Cola bottler for Chile, Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay.

NYSE_KOF.name: Coca-Cola FEMSA
NYSE_KOF.why: Coca-Cola bottler for Mexico, Brazil and other Latin American territories.

XPRA_KOFOL.name: Kofola CeskoSlovensko
XPRA_KOFOL.why: Central European soft-drink maker with its own brands and the PepsiCo bottling licence in Czechia and Slovakia.

NYSE_CAG.name: Conagra Brands
NYSE_CAG.why: Frozen and shelf-stable packaged food; Swiss Miss cocoa is a small part.

NASDAQ_KHC.name: The Kraft Heinz Company
NASDAQ_KHC.why: Packaged food group; Maxwell House, Kool-Aid and MiO drinks are a small part.

NASDAQ_CPB.name: The Campbell's Company
NASDAQ_CPB.why: Soups, sauces and snacks; V8 juice is a small part.

NASDAQ_JJSF.name: J&J Snack Foods
NASDAQ_JJSF.why: Frozen snacks for food service and retail plus ICEE frozen beverages.

NYSE_SJM.name: The J. M. Smucker Company
NYSE_SJM.why: Packaged coffee (Folgers, Cafe Bustelo, Dunkin') is the largest segment; also sweet baked goods, spreads and pet food.

NYSE_BGS.name: B&G Foods
NYSE_BGS.why: Shelf-stable and frozen packaged food brands.

NYSE_GIS.name: General Mills
NYSE_GIS.why: Cereal, snacks, baking, pet food and food service.

NASDAQ_HAIN.name: The Hain Celestial Group
NASDAQ_HAIN.why: Natural and organic packaged food and drinks (Celestial Seasonings tea).

NYSE_MKC.name: McCormick
NYSE_MKC.why: Spices, seasonings and flavours for retail and food makers.

XSWX_NESN.name: Nestle
XSWX_NESN.why: Largest food company; coffee (Nescafe, Nespresso, Starbucks at-home) and water are large parts.

NASDAQ_SENEA.name: Seneca Foods
NASDAQ_SENEA.why: Canned and frozen vegetables and fruit, mostly private label.

NYSE_POST.name: Post Holdings
NYSE_POST.why: Cereal, refrigerated food, pet food and food service; spun off BellRing in 2022.

NASDAQ_LWAY.name: Lifeway Foods
NASDAQ_LWAY.why: Kefir and other cultured dairy drinks made in its own plants.

NASDAQ_OTLY.name: Oatly Group
NASDAQ_OTLY.why: Oat-based milk alternatives, made in own and partner plants.

XPAR_BN.name: Danone
XPAR_BN.why: Dairy and plant-based products are the largest segment; also specialised nutrition and Evian/Volvic water.

XSWX_EMMN.name: Emmi
XSWX_EMMN.why: Swiss dairy processor; milk drinks, yogurt, cheese and ready-to-drink coffee.

XTSE_SAP.name: Saputo
XTSE_SAP.why: Dairy processor (milk, cheese, cultured products) in North America, Europe and Australia.

NYSE_BRCC.name: BRC Inc. (Black Rifle Coffee)
NYSE_BRCC.why: Branded packaged coffee and ready-to-drink coffee sold through grocery, online and a few shops.

NASDAQ_WEST.name: Westrock Coffee
NASDAQ_WEST.why: Business-to-business coffee, tea and extract roaster and ready-to-drink maker for retail and restaurant brands.

NASDAQ_JVA.name: Coffee Holding
NASDAQ_JVA.why: Wholesale green and roasted coffee and private-label roasting.

NASDAQ_SMPL.name: The Simply Good Foods Company
NASDAQ_SMPL.why: Quest, Atkins and OWYN protein bars, snacks and shakes; outsourced production.

NYSE_BRBR.name: BellRing Brands
NYSE_BRBR.why: Premier Protein ready-to-drink shakes and Dymatize powders; outsourced production.

XDUB_GL9.name: Glanbia
XDUB_GL9.why: Optimum Nutrition and other sports-nutrition brands plus dairy nutrition ingredients.
XDUB_GL9.channel: direct to industrial or OEM customers

NYSE_HLF.name: Herbalife
NYSE_HLF.why: Protein shakes and supplements sold through direct selling.

NYSE_MED.name: Medifast
NYSE_MED.why: Weight-management meal replacements sold through coaches.

NYSE_USNA.name: USANA Health Sciences
NYSE_USNA.why: Supplements and nutrition products sold through direct selling.

NYSE_DMC.name: Del Monte (formerly Fresh Del Monte)
NYSE_DMC.why: Grows and distributes bananas, pineapples and fresh-cut produce; juice and packaged products are small.

NYSE_DOLE.name: Dole plc
NYSE_DOLE.why: Fresh fruit and vegetables grower and distributor.

NASDAQ_LMNR.name: Limoneira
NASDAQ_LMNR.why: Lemon and avocado grower and packer.

NASDAQ_SBUX.name: Starbucks
NASDAQ_SBUX.why: Company-run and licensed coffee shops plus packaged-coffee licensing.

NASDAQ_BRCB.name: Black Rock Coffee Bar
NASDAQ_BRCB.why: Coffee and energy-drink shops with drive-throughs.

NYSE_BROS.name: Dutch Bros
NYSE_BROS.why: Drive-through coffee and energy-drink shops, mostly company-run.

NASDAQ_DNUT.name: Krispy Kreme
NASDAQ_DNUT.why: Doughnut and coffee shops plus delivered doughnuts to grocery.

NASDAQ_THCH.name: TH International (Tims China)
NASDAQ_THCH.why: Tim Hortons coffee shops in China.

NASDAQ_DPZ.name: Domino's Pizza
NASDAQ_DPZ.why: Pizza delivery and carry-out; mostly franchised, with its own supply chain.

NYSE_QSR.name: Restaurant Brands International
NYSE_QSR.why: Tim Hortons, Burger King, Popeyes and Firehouse Subs; mostly franchised.

NYSE_YUM.name: Yum! Brands
NYSE_YUM.why: KFC, Taco Bell and Pizza Hut; almost all franchised.
NYSE_YUM.window_why: Yum China spin-off Nov 2016; FY2017 is the first year with both balance sheets after it

NYSE_YUMC.name: Yum China
NYSE_YUMC.why: KFC and Pizza Hut in China, mostly company-run; also K Coffee.

XPAR_SAVE.name: Savencia Fromage & Dairy
XPAR_SAVE.why: French cheese and dairy group (formerly Bongrain), one of the largest cheese makers in the world; dairy is essentially the whole business, comparable with Emmi and Saputo. (added 2026-10-27, peer review for thin tags; Fiscal.ai profile)

XMIL_CLI.name: Centrale del Latte d'Italia
XMIL_CLI.why: Italian dairy (third-largest Italian dairy operator per its profile): fresh and UHT milk, yogurt, butter and plant-based drinks. (added 2026-10-27, peer review for thin tags; Fiscal.ai profile)

XMIL_VLS.name: Valsoia
XMIL_VLS.why: Italian plant-based food maker: soy and other dairy alternatives (drinks, yogurts, ice cream) and meat alternatives; the closest European listed peer to Oatly. (added 2026-10-27, peer review for thin tags; Fiscal.ai profile)

XWAR_MLP.name: Milkpol
XWAR_MLP.why: Polish dairy processor: milk, cottage cheese, sour cream, yogurt, kefir and buttermilk; small. (added 2026-10-27, peer review for thin tags; Fiscal.ai profile)

XMIL_ORS.name: Orsero
XMIL_ORS.why: Imports and distributes fresh fruit and vegetables across Mediterranean Europe with its own shipping, ripening and distribution - the same sourcing-and-distribution model as Dole and Mission Produce. (added 2026-10-27, peer review for thin tags; Fiscal.ai profile)

XAMS_ACOMO.name: Acomo
XAMS_ACOMO.why: Sources, processes, packages and distributes plant-based food ingredients (nuts, dried fruit, seeds, spices, organic ingredients) - agri-food sourcing and distribution with thin margins like the produce members. (added 2026-10-27, peer review for thin tags; Fiscal.ai profile)

TSX_SWP.name: Swiss Water Decaffeinated Coffee
TSX_SWP.why: Buys green coffee, decaffeinates it with a chemical-free water process and sells it to specialty roasters and importers - a pure coffee-supply business. (added 2026-10-27, peer review for thin tags; Fiscal.ai profile)
